dict.string: Mission Control reads your agenda and manages events you explicitly ask it to create or edit.
Mission Control reads your agenda and manages events you explicitly ask it to create or edit.
Mission Control shows your reminders, completes them with Undo, and manages reminders you explicitly request.
Mission Control reads inbox messages from Apple Mail for your local dashboard. It never sends email.
Mission Control uses your microphone only when you start dictation, to prepare an editable message.
Mission Control transcribes your dictated message on device so you can review it before sending.
